prompt: What distinction is Sam drawing in his reply to Nina?
promptZh: 山姆回應妮娜時，想區分哪兩件事？

options.text: Coming in before work is useful only if a wider range of vegetables is still available.
options.zh: 上班前進菜園，只有在那時還有更多種類的菜可選才有用。
options.whyZh: 山姆確實喜歡挑菜，但沒有抱怨種類或提早去時的供應；問題是即使能到場也不能自己採。

options.text: Knowing which vegetables remain on Thursday matters more than knowing what the volunteers picked.
options.zh: 知道週四還剩什麼可摘，比知道志工已摘了什麼更重要。
options.whyZh: 菜園目前的確只記已採的品項，但山姆在說的是能不能實際領到菜，不是在比較兩種紀錄的價值。

options.text: An earlier opening lets residents pick their own, but may leave less to collect for the kitchen.
options.zh: 提早開放能讓住戶自行採摘，但可能使社區廚房收得到的菜變少。
options.whyZh: 廚房收到的是志工所採的菜，但山姆沒談廚房或菜量；他強調自己有空前往卻不能親手採摘。

options.text: Making the garden easier to visit does not help everyone obtain vegetables to use at home.
options.zh: 讓住戶更容易到菜園，不等於每個人都能拿到蔬菜回家使用。
options.whyZh: 現行開放只讓來訪者自行採摘，沒有預留領取的方式；山姆週四有空卻無法自己摘，說的是入園便利和實際分到菜不同。

explanationZh: 現行開放只讓來訪者自行採摘，沒有預留領取的方式；山姆週四有空卻無法自己摘，說的是入園便利和實際分到菜不同。

vocabulary.note: 能前往菜園與能實際取得當天的蔬菜，是兩個不同條件。

evidence: The Thursday harvest is open to residents whether or not they work in the garden. Anyone who comes in can pick vegetables from the marked beds. We do not normally set anything aside for people who cannot pick their own; once the Thursday volunteers leave, any vegetables they have collected go to the community kitchen. At present, the volunteers write down what was picked but not what was still available. / Nina said an earlier opening would let her in before work. Sam replied, ‘A path to the harvest isn’t the same as a share of it.’ Sam is already free on Thursdays. He said that he enjoys choosing vegetables to cook, but cannot pick them himself. He had asked the garden team for a small selection when they were already gathering vegetables, but had been told there was no way to leave it for him to collect.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The Thursday harvest is open to residents whether or not they work in the garden. Anyone who comes in can pick vegetables from the marked beds. We do not normally set anything aside for people who cannot pick their own; once the Thursday volunteers leave, any vegetables they have collected go to the community kitchen. At present, the volunteers write down what was picked but not what was still available.

Nina said an earlier opening would let her in before work. Sam replied, ‘A path to the harvest isn’t the same as a share of it.’ Sam is already free on Thursdays. He said that he enjoys choosing vegetables to cook, but cannot pick them himself. He had asked the garden team for a small selection when they were already gathering vegetables, but had been told there was no way to leave it for him to collect.
